name: A Fine Egg
summary: Curgle Cranklehop speaks of an egg that may hatch free of the Gordunni ogres’ evil incantations.

sections.title: What Makes It Fine
sections.body: Curgle Cranklehop says an egg has a good chance of hatching untouched by the Gordunni ogres’ wicked chanting, if conditions are ideal.

sections.title: What Curgle Does Next
sections.body: Curgle takes the egg and plans to send it to Darnassus. There, it is hoped to hatch soon.

faq.q: What makes an egg considered a fine egg?
faq.answer: Under ideal conditions, an egg may hatch free of the evil brought by Gordunni ogre incantations.
The Super Egg-O-Matic came before this step.
